violated_contract: A merge helper that claims to union keyed registry entries from both sides must not emit a document whose parsed key set is missing a key present on either side, and must not keep a shared key's body stale when only the other side edited it. Silent drop includes landing a new check inside exempt: so the id is in the file text and absent from checks:.
canonical_prevention: scripts/resolve-registry-conflict unions git stages :1:/:2:/:3: by key, inserts into the named container, and verifies the parse before writing. RegistryConflictResolverTests.test_naive_append_lands_inside_exempt fails the EOF-append that puts a new id in exempt:, test_naive_union_reverts_main_edit_to_shared_id fails keeping --changed-files when only main edited the shared command, and test_cli_resolves_git_merge_stages drives the CLI on a real conflicted merge.
